Psychological studies have found that persistent loneliness can lead to significant health issues, including weakened immune systems, increased susceptibility to memory decline, and higher risks of heart disease and mortality.

Implementing such vast systemic changes would require comprehensive policies, global collaboration, and widespread public acceptance.
